title: Applied lock (.factory/applied.lock.yaml)
description: The schema as the agent last wrote or acknowledged it: one SHA-256 per span, hashes for pinned inputs, and optional authoring provenance for the skill, binary/toolchain, exact inputs and authored outputs.

schema.description: The schema file the hashes describe, relative to the workspace root.

written_by.description: `<binary> <version>`: the binary that wrote the file, as it was invoked, and its version.

spans.description: Span key -> SHA-256 (hex) of the span's exact text. Keys: `header`, `type:<Name>`, `<method>:<path>` (an inventory operation), `Query.<field>` / `Mutation.<field>` (a root field the inventory does not explain).

inventory.description: SHA-256 (hex) of `.factory/inventory.json` as compact JSON, so formatting never counts as an edit. The inventory is the tool's own output and is never hand-edited: a correction belongs in the pinned spec (`codify --source`) or, when it is a judgement, in selection.yaml. A differing hash is reported as `unacknowledged-inventory-edit`; `graphos-factory-core inventory build` refuses to overwrite such a file without `--force`.

sources.description: Pinned description documents (sources.lock.yaml entries of kind openapi/swagger): working-copy path -> SHA-256 (hex) of the document's compact JSON as last acknowledged, so formatting never counts as an edit. Written by `graphos-factory-core lock` and `sources pin`, refreshed by `codify --source`.

name.description: The binary the lock was written by: the product binary's own name, a constant, never the name it was invoked under (the `graphos-factory-core` link every product installs records the product). Absent from locks written before the name was recorded.

revision.description: Git revision of the source tree when Cargo built the binary, or `unknown`.

dirty.description: Whether the source tree was dirty when Cargo built the binary. This is true when Git state was unavailable.

omitted_outputs.description: Authored output paths that were not hashed. Test-tree symlinks are listed here and are never followed.

source.description: What named the skill checkout: `--skill-dir`, `binary-build` (the binary's own build), or the environment variable the root was read under, GRAPHOS_FACTORY_CORE_SKILL_ROOT or GRAPHOS_FACTORY_CORE_SCRIPTS today. Any variable ending in _SKILL_ROOT or _SCRIPTS is accepted, so a lock an older binary wrote under its own spelling stays valid.
